description: Save a batch of up to 25 tracks, without notes, into one collection in a single all-or-nothing call. Use it when someone keeps several search results at once, such as a shortlist. Not for a single track or a track that needs a note; use add_to_collection instead. Returns the updated collection and a results list marking each id already_present or new. Requires sign-in. Ids already saved come back marked already_present instead of duplicating, so retries are harmless. All or nothing: one unknown id, the 500-item limit, a CC BY-NC track bound for a commercial collection or a stale_revision stops the whole batch. Example: {"collection_id":"3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f6b-9c2d-1a2b3c4d5e6f","tracks":["ic-ccab784f22","fp-a3e107a24c"]}.

collection_id.description: The id of a collection returned by list_collections or create_collection (a UUID).

revision.description: The collection's current revision, returned by get_collection or list_collections; when given, the change fails with stale_revision if the collection was edited since.

tracks.description: 1 to 25 ids of tracks returned by search_tracks, find_similar or get_collection.

name: add_many_to_collection

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: Add several tracks to a collection
